Nothing has changed since the last seven checks, so I stopped without editing the game or shipping anything.

**Why it's stuck:** step 1 must decide go or stop before any of the code can be built. That needs the "split" measurement: two separate processes, player 2's stall gap under 50 ms, and its frame gaps. That measurement still hasn't been run:
- `tools/handoff/console/notes/95/` still doesn't exist.
- The codex measurements folder still holds only `raw-camera-shared-t1.json`. That is the "before" baseline: today player 2 freezes for about 2010 ms when player 1 is busy for 2 s.
- My allowed commands can't run `measure95.mjs` or `run-measure95.ps1`. They have to read player 2's window and process from outside the page, which a camera recipe can't do. Alarms already ask the coordinator to run it.

**What unblocks it:** the coordinator runs `run-measure95.ps1` (ready since 10-22) and copies the raw split files into `notes/95/`. The next run then decides go or stop and, on a go, builds steps 2 to 7 behind an experimental switch that stays off by default.

I added this as the 8th check in `tools/handoff/console/notes/95-p2-own-process.md`, with a request to stop requeuing the job until the files are there.
